_comment: Business Mapping — Output of Phase 2 (Separation). Maps generic placeholders in logical_graph.yaml back to real business terms. This file is the ONLY place domain knowledge lives. It is used by config.json assembly (Phase 6) and output rehydration (Phase 7).
_rules: Every placeholder in logical_graph.yaml MUST have an entry here
No entry here should appear anywhere in atom code
This file is never sent to cloud LLM during atom creation (Phase 5)
Column mappings, thresholds, formulas with real names all live here
